questions.question: What does Cursor cost for a team, seat by seat?
questions.answer_summary: Cursor Teams Standard is $40/seat monthly ($32 annual) with a dual usage pool; Teams Premium is $120/seat monthly ($96 annual) with 5x Standard's included usage.

questions.question: What does GitHub Copilot cost at Business vs Enterprise tier?
questions.answer_summary: Copilot Business is $19/seat with $19 in pooled AI credits; Enterprise effectively runs about $60/seat once the required GitHub Enterprise Cloud base ($21/user) is factored in, with $39 in pooled credits.

questions.question: What does Claude Code's Team plan cost per seat?
questions.answer_summary: Team Standard runs about $25/seat ($20 annual) and Team Premium about $125/seat ($100 annual), with Claude Code typically only available on Premium seats, minimum 5 seats.

questions.question: What is a realistic monthly cost per developer for heavy AI coding tool usage?
questions.answer_summary: Anthropic's own /cost telemetry shows an average of $6/developer/day (90% under $12/day); broader industry surveys find nearly 25% of tech leaders already spend $200-$500 per developer monthly, with ~6% exceeding $2,000.

questions.question: How much did Uber spend on Claude Code, and what does that reveal about enterprise costs?
questions.answer_summary: A widely discussed report claimed Uber exhausted its entire 2026 AI budget on Claude Code within four months; HN commenters attributed this to long uncompressed conversations, many parallel subagents/worktrees, and 'reward high token usage as productivity' incentive problems.

questions.question: Is $150-200/month per developer for Claude Code worth it?
questions.answer_summary: Commenters argue yes if it delivers even a 30% productivity gain for an $8k/month engineer (worth $2,400+), making even $1,000/month subscriptions rational for employers, though skeptics ask for proof the spend converts to real business value.

questions.question: Why is Cursor's team billing considered a bigger cost risk than Copilot's?
questions.answer_summary: Cursor's usage-based agent mode plus premium seat tiers (up to $120/seat) create wider variance and higher ceilings than Copilot's flatter, credit-pooled Business tier at $19/seat.

questions.question: Do standard code completions cost extra on GitHub Copilot?
questions.answer_summary: No — standard completions remain unmetered on paid Copilot plans; only agent mode and premium models consume metered AI Credits at $0.01/credit.

questions.question: What usage profile determines whether a developer spends $20 vs $200+/month?
questions.answer_summary: Light solo use (chat/autocomplete) runs $10-$20/month, daily professional agent use runs $60-$100/month, and agentic power users running multi-step autonomous tasks or parallel agents run $200+/month.

questions.question: Is Claude Code Team plan the same as the $200 Max 20x plan?
questions.answer_summary: No — a Hacker News commenter clarifies their company's team plan was actually $150/seat, not the same as the individual $200/month Max 20x subscription tier, a common point of confusion.
